## Où j'en suis
Fernhill SAML SSO on branch `daniel/saml-sso-fernhill` is demo-ready except for one external dependency: real SP-initiated login works end to end on staging after the short RelayState fix (Redis, 10-min TTL), JIT creates users as `viewer`, and per-tenant group-to-role mapping is implemented in open PR #421. PR #415 (JIT provisioning) is merged. Waiting on Fernhill IT to add the groups claim before the demo Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 ET; go-live Dec 1. (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" is open, not merged; commits `6d0e2b8` (opaque RelayState) and `f4a91c7` (role mapping), 41 auth tests + full suite green (source: ses-sso-3)
- [prochaine-étape] Fernhill IT adds the groups claim (Daniel emailing them), then create an admin test account alongside `kestrel.test1` before Thursday's demo (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] get #421 merged before the Dec 1 go-live (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] first real login failed: Fernhill's ADFS rejected RelayState over 80 bytes (MSIS7042) because we sent the full return URL; fixed by storing the URL server-side with a short opaque ID (source: ses-sso-3)
- [question] nothing pending on the Fernhill IT Slack request: Daniel rejected switching default to `analyst` (no such role) and IdP-initiated-only (source: ses-sso-3, src-slack-fernhill)
- [décision] JIT only creates users from verified email domains, never unverified ones (source: ses-sso-2, src-pr415)
- [décision] SAML only, both login flows; default role is `viewer` (source: ses-sso-1, ses-sso-3)
